statement: The function returns a result r and r is the minimum, over all finite sequences of starts s_1,...,s_m with 0 <= m <= numCarpets and 0 <= s_j <= n - carpetLen for every j, of the number of indices i with 0 <= i < n, floor[i] = 49, and i not in [s_j, s_j + carpetLen) for every j. Equivalently, r is the minimum number of white tiles visible after covering tiles by at most numCarpets carpets, each covering carpetLen consecutive tiles, with overlaps allowed; a carpet with start s covers indices s through s + carpetLen - 1.
preconditions: Let n = len(floor). 1 <= carpetLen <= n <= 1000, 1 <= numCarpets <= 1000, and for every i with 0 <= i < n, floor[i] is either 48 (the byte '0') or 49 (the byte '1').
